reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: Remote work has fundamentally transformed urban development patterns over the past decade. As companies embrace flexible work arrangements, fewer employees commute daily to city centers, reducing traffic congestion and environmental pollution. However, this shift has created challenges for urban economies that traditionally relied on office workers to support local businesses. Some cities have successfully adapted by converting office spaces into residential apartments and promoting mixed-use developments. Urban planners must now balance the benefits of reduced congestion with the need to maintain vibrant, economically sustainable city centers.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of remote work for cities?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'fewer employees commute daily to city centers, reducing traffic congestion and environmental pollution'이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What challenge does the passage mention regarding remote work?
questions.explanation: 지문의 'this shift has created challenges for urban economies that traditionally relied on office workers to support local businesses'에서 답을 찾을 수 있습니다.

questions.q: How have some cities adapted to these changes?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Some cities have successfully adapted by converting office spaces into residential apartments and promoting mixed-use developments'라고 설명하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Remote work is better for employees than working in a traditional office.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장을 제시하세요. '~에 동의한다/하지 않는다'는 의견을 직접 표현하고, 2-3개의 주요 이유를 미리 언급하세요.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유를 전개하세요. 구체적인 예시나 데이터를 포함하여 주장을 뒷받침하세요. 원격 근무의 유연성, 출퇴근 시간 절약, 업무 집중도 등을 다룰 수 있습니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이유를 설명하세요. 첫 번째 단락과 달라야 하며, 일과 삶의 균형, 사회적 상호작용, 경력 발전 등의 관점에서 논할 수 있습니다.
structure.conclusion: 주요 주장을 재정리하고 최종 의견을 강조하세요. 반론을 인정하면서도 당신의 입장이 더 타당함을 암시적으로 표현하세요.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work offers significant advantages...

speaking.prompt: Some people believe that companies should require employees to work in offices. Others believe that remote work should be the default option. Which position do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my perspective, I believe that remote work is more beneficial because...
One significant reason is that employees can have greater flexibility and focus...
Additionally, remote work reduces environmental impact through decreased commuting...
However, I acknowledge that in-office work has certain advantages...

sample_points: 원격 근무는 직원들에게 유연성과 생산성 향상을 제공합니다. 통근 시간이 줄어들면서 업무에 더 많은 시간을 할애할 수 있고, 집중력 있는 환경에서 일할 수 있습니다.
원격 근무는 환경 보호와 비용 절감에 기여합니다. 탄소 배출이 감소하고, 회사는 사무실 운영 비용을 절감하여 직원 급여나 혜택 개선에 투자할 수 있습니다.

listening.title: Professor discussing urban planning and remote work trends
listening.script: Today, I want to discuss how remote work is reshaping our cities. Historically, urban development has centered around downtown business districts where thousands of office workers converged daily. However, the pandemic accelerated a trend that was already beginning: the rise of remote work. Companies discovered that many employees could work effectively from home, which fundamentally changed real estate demands. Now, we're seeing significant shifts in urban landscapes. Downtown office vacancies have increased in many cities, prompting developers to think creatively. Some are converting these older office buildings into luxury apartments or mixed-use spaces. Others are reimagining downtown areas with recreational facilities and cultural centers to attract residents and visitors. Meanwhile, suburban areas are experiencing unexpected growth as people relocate to quieter regions while maintaining remote positions. This creates interesting challenges for city planners. They must decide how to revitalize downtown areas while accommodating this shift. The future of urban development will depend on how effectively cities adapt to these changing work patterns.

questions.q: What is the main topic of this lecture?
options: The history of downtown office buildings
How remote work is changing urban development
questions.explanation: 교수는 원격 근무가 도시 발전에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 대해 강의하고 있습니다. 주제는 'how remote work is reshaping our cities'입니다.

questions.q: According to the lecture, what are developers doing with vacant office buildings?
options: Converting them to apartments or mixed-use spaces
questions.explanation: 강의에서 'Some are converting these older office buildings into luxury apartments or mixed-use spaces'라고 명확히 설명합니다.

questions.q: What challenge do city planners face according to the professor?
options: Deciding how to revitalize downtown while adapting to work pattern changes
questions.explanation: 교수는 'They must decide how to revitalize downtown areas while accommodating this shift'라고 도시 계획자들이 직면한 도전 과제를 설명합니다.
